visual.scope: Expected interactables found across 60 controlled browser screens. This is semantic DOM, ARIA and OCR recall, not pixel box accuracy.

pii.scope: 295 labelled synthetic cases. Precision is shown first, recall second.

redaction.scope: Controlled supplied-box pixel masks verified, with detected text entities removed from sanitized context.

latency.scope: Median across 3 of 3 completed controlled live-product tasks.

resources.scope: 1.26 GB peak aggregate Chromium test profile. Extension-only RAM is not yet isolated.

caveat: Controlled results validate the prototype. A human-reviewed face and document dataset, pixel-level UI grounding benchmark, extension-only resource measurement and larger independent task suite remain required before production claims.
